newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Common Fund agrees new commodity strategy.
newsitem.headline: Common Fund agrees new commodity strategy.

text.p: The Common Fund for Commodities, a U.N. affiliate, said on Wednesday it had agreed a strategy for cooperation with international bodies like the International Cocoa Organization and the International Coffee Organization.

"The Common Fund has set clear guidelines which assist the International Commodity Bodies (ICBs)...and in the formulation of commodity development projects for financing by the Fund," it said in a statement.

Under the new strategy, projects would be expected to include features such as the development of new end-uses or new plant varieties that would give higher yields or show increased resistance to disease and climate problems.
Projects should also aim to improve the international competitiveness of a commodity through higher productivity or reduction of post-harvest losses.
Promoting the consumption of commodities was also highlighted.
